A request for a non-existent OData entity URL must return 404 Not Found.

What the Standard says

The OASIS OData 4.01 protocol defines this service response requirement. read it here.

Why it matters

Enforcing this rule gives callers and maintainers one predictable contract and makes drift visible during the build. The analyser proves this specific source-level condition; it does not replace runtime acceptance or security testing.

Bad code example

// Violates ODATA0002
return Ok(student); // student may be null

Good code example

// Follows ODATA0002
return student is null ? NotFound() : Ok(student);
